evals.prompt: Mình có idea video: startup chỉ có 4 developer thì có thật sự cần microservices không? Bắt đầu workflow giúp mình.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes an initial prompt, performs only current sourced discovery, presents concise distinct directions, and waits for the user's choice instead of writing the script.
expectations: The response identifies the work as Discover and stops at directions_proposed
It uses current authoritative sources and separates sourced facts from inference
It presents two to four narratively distinct directions without repeating them in multiple sections
The recommended tension hook is supportable by the evidence and resolves to a concrete payoff
It asks one compact direction-choice question and does not draft a full script or production plan

evals.prompt: Project này research xong rồi. Viết script luôn cho tôi để qua production.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the supplied state, detects that directions were proposed but none was selected, and blocks script generation with a compact choice request.
expectations: It identifies directions_proposed and the absence of direction.json
It does not invent a selection or write a full script/video plan
It presents the existing direction IDs and asks the user to select or combine them
It does not call Kokoro, create Remotion code, or render
It explains that Phase 2 starts only after direction_selected is recorded

evals.prompt: Script này tôi approve rồi, render final MP4 đi.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the supplied approval artifacts, detects the stale script checksum, blocks production, and asks for re-approval of the current script without running TTS or Remotion.
expectations: It compares video.json.scriptVersion, approval.approvedScriptVersion, and state.json versions.script
It explicitly identifies the approval as stale because the versions do not match
It blocks Kokoro generation, Remotion preview, and final rendering
It requests approval for the current script version instead of trusting the user's ambiguous reference to an older approval
It does not claim that preview.mp4, final.mp4, or report.json exists

evals.prompt: The English script is approved. Produce a short video about DNS using the repository defaults.
evals.expected_output: Uses the shared Kokoro generator and karaoke component, implements topic-specific motion, and checks sequential rendered frames before final output.
expectations: Keeps narration, titles and captions in English
Uses measured words in the voice manifest rather than proportional sentence timing
Shows one currently spoken word with a high-contrast highlight
Plans visible actions inside each main explanatory scene rather than static slides with only a progress bar
Reviews consecutive word and motion frames, including a later scene or audio chunk
Does not copy another topic's terminology or its fixed scene structure into DNS
Includes purposeful background music without another user reminder and records the sound plan and audio review evidence

evals.prompt: For this video I explicitly want static diagrams and ordinary phrase captions, without karaoke.
evals.expected_output: Treats this as an explicit project override, records phrase mode and the static-style choice, and does not change repository defaults.
expectations: Honors the user's visual and caption override
Uses captions.mode phrase and a corresponding renderer implementation
Does not force the default karaoke gate or change defaults for other projects

evals.prompt: Explain how the existing karaoke timestamp mapping works. Do not generate or modify a video.
evals.expected_output: Explains the shared timestamp and caption code read-only without starting a production workflow.
expectations: Reads the shared generator, caption validation and renderer helper as needed
Distinguishes provider-predicted word timestamps from independent forced alignment
Does not create a project, synthesize speech or render

evals.prompt: You forgot the background sound. Add it to the existing approved eclipse video so it feels more curious and emotional.
evals.expected_output: Resumes Produce for the existing video, checks actual mix behavior, implements an audible emotional arc, and exports the scoped revision with honest audio QC.
expectations: Reads short-video-production and the background-sound defaults
Inspects the existing soundtrack and renderer instead of assuming no music file exists
Records hook, explanation, reveal and ending cues, effective mix levels, and speech ducking
Preserves approved narration and visuals and does not restart discovery or request redundant approval
Checks the rendered mix and distinguishes measurements from any unperformed listening review

evals.prompt: The video feels emotionally flat. There is a quiet low drone at volume 0.13 and the MP4 already measures -16 LUFS. Improve the sound; don't change the script.
evals.expected_output: Treats stream presence, a volume scalar and full-mix loudness as insufficient; traces and improves the background's musical role and actual audibility.
expectations: Does not declare the background adequate based on volume 0.13 or full-mix LUFS
Checks effective background level after all gains/fades and its relationship to narration
Shapes a topic-appropriate emotional arc rather than only turning up a generic drone
Checks hook, dense speech, payoff and ending and records mono or phone-listening limitations
Does not rewrite approved narration or claim measured audience retention improvements

evals.prompt: For this approved video, export voice and captions only. No music, ambience or sound effects.
evals.expected_output: Records and honors a project-level sound override while leaving the shared sound defaults intact.
expectations: Does not add music or substitute ambience/SFX against the explicit instruction
Records the user override and checks that background layers are excluded from the export
Does not demand another confirmation or change defaults for future projects

evals.prompt: Finish the approved video with background music. This environment can measure and render audio but has no listening capability.
evals.expected_output: Completes authorized production and technical measurements while recording listening as not-performed instead of inventing a pass or blocking unnecessarily.
expectations: Records sound intent, cues, track provenance, effective stem levels, and final loudness/peak measurements
Ties QC evidence to the current audio asset and final MP4 checksums
Marks listening not-performed and discloses the limitation in the delivery
Does not claim phone-speaker intelligibility or emotional effectiveness was verified
Does not request redundant permission for already-authorized local production

evals.prompt: Explain music versus ambience versus sound effects. Do not create or change any video.
evals.expected_output: Answers the general audio question read-only without activating production or allocating a video project.
expectations: Does not create a project, write a sound plan, change files, synthesize audio or render
Distinguishes ongoing music/ambience from event-specific sound effects

evals.prompt: Improve the background music in the existing video. The proposed track requires buying a license, but I haven't authorized any purchase.
evals.expected_output: Uses an appropriate authorized local or original alternative if possible; does not buy a license or sign up for a service without authorization.
expectations: Inspects the available library and existing rights records before selecting audio
Does not buy a license, create an account or introduce a paid integration without authorization
Continues with a suitable authorized alternative or prepares a concrete selection before requesting any necessary purchase approval
Does not treat mandatory background sound as authorization for spending

evals.prompt: The eclipse video is already approved and produced. Its background is too subtle; make it more curious and uplifting, keep narration and visuals, and export a replacement. Give a dry-run only: inspect existing artifacts, list exact revision commands, settings, QC and deliverables. Do not render, edit the project, purchase media or browse. Listening is unavailable in this test.
evals.expected_output: Executable scoped revision plan with preserved approval boundaries and explicit QC limits.
expectations: Preserves approved narration and visual scope; does not restart discovery or request duplicate approval.
Provides an executable production-only configuration path without manually rewriting approval hashes.
Includes purposeful sound arc, actual mix tracing, final measurements and a current preview before final.
Marks unavailable listening not-performed; does not claim audibility or emotional fit from stream presence.
evals.name: sound-correction

evals.prompt: The already-produced queue video needs one corrected sentence in the limits scene. I approve this replacement: "Retries can recover transient failures, but cannot fix broken application code." Keep the other narration and style and export the corrected video. Give a dry-run only with exact versioning, regeneration and preview/final steps. Do not modify project artifacts or render.
evals.expected_output: Executable scoped revision plan with preserved approval boundaries and explicit QC limits.
expectations: Uses supported script draft/approval transitions from produced state and preserves the old final.
Accepts the explicit sentence approval without asking for the same approval again.
Regenerates only changed narration where supported and preserves six unchanged WAVs/timing.
Rechecks timeline/caption synchronization and requires a current preview before final.
evals.name: narration-revision

evals.prompt: Revise the already-produced eclipse video: voice only, no music or SFX, and phrase captions instead of highlighted words. Keep the script and visuals. Give a dry-run with the concrete configuration, commands and QC required for the replacement final. Do not modify project artifacts, synthesize, or render.
evals.expected_output: Executable scoped revision plan with preserved approval boundaries and explicit QC limits.
expectations: Implements explicit voice-only with music and SFX disabled and phrase captions actually supported by the renderer.
Preserves script approval and avoids TTS or restarting discovery for production-only settings.
Explains current preview, technical QC and separate listening limits.
evals.name: sound-override
